assessment: The candidate delivered an accurate, low-friction cancellation flow: it gave the self-service route immediately, explained continued access through the paid period, and stated the no-refund policy honestly. All judges confirmed strong policy adherence with no rule violations. The main and consistent weakness is the absence of any empathetic acknowledgment of the customer's budget constraint or their expressed liking of the recipes, leaving the interaction feeling flat. The optional retention discount was never offered, which was permitted but left the scenario goal unexercised.
judge_agreement: Judges unanimously agreed on policy honesty (9-10) and resolution quality (9-10), praising the direct, frictionless cancellation path. They disagreed on empathy (range 5-8): all noted the missing acknowledgment of the customer's situation, but differed on how much that coldness should cost given the otherwise respectful, pressure-free handling.
